messages.mission.iron-dust.title: Iron Dust
messages.mission.iron-dust.objective.short: Destroy the command core; keep at least one friendly unit alive.
messages.mission.iron-dust.objective.full: Destroy the enemy command core. The mission is lost if all friendly units are eliminated.
messages.mission.iron-dust.briefing.short: Advance on the command core and destroy it.
messages.mission.iron-dust.briefing.full: The enemy command core is your target. Use cover and range as you advance. You win when the core is destroyed and at least one friendly unit survives.
messages.mission.iron-dust.end.victory: The enemy command core has been destroyed.
messages.mission.relay-run.title: Relay Run
messages.mission.relay-run.objective.short: Eliminate the relay node and all enemies; keep a friendly unit alive.
messages.mission.relay-run.objective.full: Destroy the enemy relay node and eliminate every remaining enemy unit. At least one friendly unit must survive.
messages.mission.relay-run.briefing.short: Eliminate the relay node and its entire escort.
messages.mission.relay-run.briefing.full: The relay node lies east of the combat area. Destroy it and eliminate all enemy units. The mission fails if no friendly unit survives.
messages.mission.relay-run.end.victory: The relay node and enemy units have been eliminated.
messages.mission.unit-trial.title: Unit Trial
messages.mission.unit-trial.objective.short: Eliminate the command center and all enemies; keep a friendly unit alive.
messages.mission.unit-trial.objective.full: Destroy the enemy command center and eliminate every remaining enemy unit. At least one friendly unit must survive.
messages.mission.unit-trial.briefing.short: Test your units against the enemy command center.
messages.mission.unit-trial.briefing.full: This mission pits varied units against a mixed defense. Destroy the command center and eliminate all enemy units. The mission fails if all friendly units are eliminated.
messages.mission.unit-trial.end.victory: The command center and enemy units have been eliminated.
messages.mission.atlas-proving-grounds.title: Atlas Proving Grounds
Eliminate the enemy core and all enemies; keep a friendly unit alive.
Destroy the enemy command core and eliminate every remaining enemy unit. At least one friendly unit must survive.
messages.mission.atlas-proving-grounds.briefing.s: Eliminate the enemy core and every remaining opponent.
messages.mission.atlas-proving-grounds.briefing.f: The proving ground contains many terrain and unit types. Destroy the enemy command core and eliminate all enemy units. The mission fails if all friendly units are eliminated.
messages.mission.atlas-proving-grounds.end.victor: The command core and all enemy units have been eliminated.
messages.mission.reference-v1.title: Reference Game
messages.mission.reference-v1.objective.short: Destroy the enemy core; keep a friendly unit alive.
messages.mission.reference-v1.objective.full: Destroy the enemy core. At least one friendly unit must survive.
messages.mission.reference-v1.briefing.short: Test game: eliminate the enemy core.
messages.mission.reference-v1.briefing.full: This fixed reference game tests movement, fire and victory conditions in the modular rules core. Destroy the enemy core; the mission fails if all friendly units are eliminated.
messages.mission.reference-v1.end.victory: The enemy core has been destroyed.
messages.mission.phase-v2.title: Phase Game
messages.mission.phase-v2.objective.short: Destroy the enemy core; keep a friendly unit alive.
messages.mission.phase-v2.objective.full: Destroy the enemy core. At least one friendly unit must survive.
messages.mission.phase-v2.briefing.short: Test game: use movement, fire and the skimmer maneuver.
messages.mission.phase-v2.briefing.full: This fixed test game shows movement, fire and the second skimmer maneuver. Destroy the enemy core; the mission fails if all friendly units are eliminated.
messages.mission.phase-v2.end.victory: The enemy core has been destroyed.
messages.phase.movement.label: Movement Phase
messages.phase.fire.label: Fire Phase
messages.phase.gev.label: Skimmer Maneuver
messages.phase.enemy.label: Enemy Turn
messages.dialog.phaseAdvance.title: End phase?
messages.dialog.phaseAdvance.pending.one: {pendingCount} unit can still act in this phase.
messages.dialog.phaseAdvance.pending.other: {pendingCount} units can still act in this phase.
messages.dialog.phaseAdvance.pending.none: No units can still act in this phase.
messages.dialog.phaseAdvance.remember: Do not ask again when changing phase
messages.dialog.restart.title: Restart mission?
messages.dialog.restart.body: The mission will start over. Your orders and progress so far will be lost.
messages.dialog.changeMission.title: Change mission?
messages.dialog.changeMission.body: The current mission will end. Your progress will be lost. Then {nextMissionName} will start.
messages.screen.missionEnd.victory.title: Mission complete
messages.screen.missionEnd.defeat.title: Mission failed
messages.screen.missionEnd.defeat.allUnits: All friendly units have been eliminated.
messages.screen.help.title: How to play
messages.screen.help.reference-v1.short: Select a unit, mark a target and confirm the order.
messages.screen.help.reference-v1.full: Select a friendly unit. Mark a valid movement cell or, during the Fire Phase, a valid enemy target and confirm the order. The phase display shows when movement and fire are available.
messages.screen.help.phase-v2.short: Use movement, fire and the skimmer maneuver in sequence.
messages.screen.help.phase-v2.full: Select a friendly unit and confirm a valid target. The Fire Phase follows the Movement Phase. Eligible skimmers can then perform their second maneuver. The phase display shows the next step.
